text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest single-digit gains, suggesting measured recovery rather than conviction buying. Fear & Greed at 30 with a recent uptick indicates sentiment is still weighted toward caution, though the slight 7-day improvement hints that some accumulation may be starting. Bitcoin's 56.8% dominance coupled with $51B in daily volume reflects a market consolidating around the major asset rather than rushing into altcoin speculation.
